scope: Bind the browser board, profiles and role to the current human, workspace selection incarnation and latest request; suppress stale delivery and callbacks without changing server authority or default actions.

clean_commands.scope: Full selected web unit and shared synthetic browser suite, including both new rendered board regressions

notification_runtime.counting: Repeated setup, dispatch and redaction labels are not 41 independent acceptance cases

clean_commands.counting: Stage counts are invocation totals, not unique cases; dependencies, notification runtime, W03 and full verification are counted separately

regression_proof: Before the correction, 15 of the original 18 mounted cases failed and three healthy/current-creation/unmount controls passed; two failures were unavailable-role display contracts, not independent security races
A separate healthy HTTP-200 response with a different human failed against the initial correction; the final source rejects it before installing any board or profiles
Workspace or human changes suppress the previous board, profiles and role immediately; A-to-B-to-A cannot revive the first A selection
Entry, HTTP and each body await, success, error and final loading updates share committed selection and newest-request guards
Late old creation callbacks cannot begin an old-scope read or select a task in the new scope; genuine current callbacks still refresh and select committed tasks
Current HTTP, network and body failures remove stale content and report unavailable role instead of cached membership authority; browser retry works with Enter
Picker and popstate workspace changes reset selected task and composer; an unmounted shell has no late completion effects
Rendered browser cases keep the current Reviewer role after a delayed prior Owner board, omit Owner-only navigation and retain one Open button plus one Details disclosure per task
Clean browser captures show current synthetic content in both existing themes; they are viewport captures, not proof that all below-fold controls are pictured
browser_driver_repairs: Three initial focused runs did not select a native picker option through headless popup key sequences, before the race assertions; these are test-driver failures, not production or privacy evidence
The final tests use the standard option-selection driver and separately prove selector focus and actual keyboard retry; native popup-key navigation remains uncertified
activation_barriers: GitHub key existence policy, execution-owned delivery and destructive private retention remain open
Natural credential or lease expiry during an in-flight D1 batch remains open
Private creation, creator sharing, author-private checkpoints and C12 remain unavailable or planned
not_claimed: Complete C11 acceptance, private activation or live private R2/browser-byte delivery
A second canonical server workspace or real cross-session browser identity race: secondary workspace presentation is explicitly intercepted synthetic data
Complete browser session lifetime or profile-transport identity certification, or native popup-key behavior
Live pilot/provider/installed-app operation, deployment, external CI, separate X01/X05 or G01 runtime acceptance
New knowledge, skill catalog, vault, reminder, publication or contribution features
redaction: Bounded synthetic counts, source identities and proof labels; no credentials, private bodies, raw output or local absolute paths
